title: Published pairwise SNP distances for the three-isolate Salmonella Heidelberg outbreak set
description: Ground truth for the acceptance check in REPORT.md. These three numbers were produced by analyses that predate M-Tato and are independent of it: a SKA2 split-k-mer distance on trimmed reads, and a reference-mapping SNP call after filtering. They are an acceptance check, not a target to tune against.
tolerance_rationale: M-Tato compares ASSEMBLIES while the reference numbers come from READS (SKA2) and from a mapping-plus-filtering pipeline. Assembly errors, repeat collapsing, and differences in filtering move a 0-2 SNP distance by one or two counts without any of the methods being wrong. A discrepancy of exactly +/-1 SNP is therefore accepted and still printed; anything larger fails. make_report.py prints expected, observed and the difference for every pair, so a near-miss is never hidden.

pairs.name: isolate-A-isolate-B
pairs.source: SKA2 (split k-mer, alignment-free) distance on fastp-trimmed reads

provenance.analysis: ska build/ska distance on the read sets listed in analysis/ncbi_pd/ska/reads.tsv
provenance.cross_check: The same pair is recorded as 2.0 in analysis/results.json under ska_reads['isolate-A|isolate-B'], and as filtered_snps=2 (from raw_all_snps=37, unique_snps=32) in the assembly pairwise section of the same file.

pairs.name: isolate-A-isolate-C
pairs.source: SKA2 (split k-mer, alignment-free) distance on fastp-trimmed reads

provenance.analysis: ska build/ska distance on the read sets listed in analysis/ncbi_pd/ska/reads.tsv
provenance.cross_check: The same pair is recorded as 2.0 in analysis/results.json under ska_reads['isolate-A|isolate-C'], and as filtered_snps=2 (from raw_all_snps=17, unique_snps=16) in the assembly pairwise section of the same file.

pairs.name: isolate-B-isolate-C
pairs.source: Reference mapping followed by SNP filtering

provenance.analysis: Reads mapped to a reference, variants called and then filtered; the filtered count is what is recorded. The unfiltered call for this pair was 21 raw / 17 unique SNPs, all of which the filter removed.
provenance.cross_check: SKA2 independently reports Distance 0.00 for this pair (mismatch count 22 over 4671404 matched split k-mers) in analysis/ncbi_pd/ska/cluster_reads_distance.tsv, and analysis/results.json ska_reads['isolate-B|isolate-C'] is 0.0.

how_to_use.observed_from: M-Tato's cluster_<id>.dist.tsv SNP counts in the run output folder, joined by genome name; if a bench JSON carries pairwise errors it is used as a cross-check
how_to_use.verdict_rule: PASS when |observed - expected| <= abs_tolerance_snps for all three pairs; 'not measured' (never PASS) when M-Tato reports no distance for a pair, because the three isolates were not placed in one cluster

caveats: The expected values are READ- and MAPPING-based; M-Tato works on the ASSEMBLIES in bench-work/salmonella_trio/asm/. A disagreement of one SNP is evidence about the assemblies, not automatically a bug.
With three taxa no tree accuracy can be measured (Robinson-Foulds needs at least four), so this dataset contributes distance accuracy only.
If isolate-B and isolate-C are 0 SNPs apart they may be collapsed into one profile group; M-Tato must still report a distance of 0 for that pair rather than omitting it.
